env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# An address into the value of an imported const composite points at a fresh variable, never at the exporter's storage.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/addrcc$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/addrcc$GOEXE
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

# An address into the storage of an imported const composite, or a slice of its array, fails with the rule ID.
cd bad
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=4 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccaddr

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
ok qualified-field
ok qualified-array
ok qualified-array-element
ok qualified-whole
ok qualified-nested-field
ok qualified-fresh-per-evaluation
ok dot-field
ok dot-array
ok dot-whole
ok read-after-writes
-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	A [3]int
	N int
}

type Wrap struct {
	In Box
	K  int
}

const C = Box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, A: [3]int{1, 2, 3}, N: 7}

const W = Wrap{In: Box{M: map[string]int{"z": 5}, N: 3}, K: 1}
-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/ccaddr/lib"
)

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool, got, want any) {
	if !cond {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name+":", "got", got, "want", want)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func qualified() {
	n := &lib.C.N
	*n = 5
	check("qualified-field", lib.C.N == 7 && *n == 5, lib.C.N, 7)

	a := &lib.C.A
	a[0] = 9
	check("qualified-array", lib.C.A[0] == 1 && a[0] == 9, lib.C.A[0], 1)

	e := &lib.C.A[1]
	*e = 8
	check("qualified-array-element", lib.C.A[1] == 2 && *e == 8, lib.C.A[1], 2)

	m := &lib.C
	m.N = 4
	m.A[2] = 6
	m.M["b"] = 2
	check("qualified-whole", lib.C.N == 7 && lib.C.A[2] == 3 && len(lib.C.M) == 1 && m.N == 4 && m.A[2] == 6, lib.C.N, 7)

	k := &lib.W.In.N
	*k = 6
	check("qualified-nested-field", lib.W.In.N == 3 && *k == 6, lib.W.In.N, 3)

	x := &lib.C.N
	y := &lib.C.N
	check("qualified-fresh-per-evaluation", x != y, x, y)
}

func main() {
	qualified()
	dotted()
	check("read-after-writes", lib.C.L[0] == 1 && lib.C.A[0] == 1 && lib.C.A[1] == 2 && lib.C.N == 7 && lib.W.In.N == 3, lib.C, "declared value")
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- m/app/dot.lgo --
package main

import . "example.com/ccaddr/lib"

func dotted() {
	n := &C.N
	*n = 5
	check("dot-field", C.N == 7 && *n == 5, C.N, 7)

	a := &C.A
	a[0] = 9
	check("dot-array", C.A[0] == 1 && a[0] == 9, C.A[0], 1)

	m := &C
	m.N = 4
	m.L[0] = 3
	check("dot-whole", C.N == 7 && C.L[0] == 1 && m.N == 4 && m.L[0] == 3, C.N, 7)
}
-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/ccaddrbad

go 1.27

-- bad/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Item struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	A [3]int
	I []Item
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, A: [3]int{1, 2, 3}, I: []Item{{N: 1}, {N: 2}}}
-- bad/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccaddrbad/lib"
)

func main() {
	p := &lib.C.L[0]
	q := &lib.C.I[1].N
	s := lib.C.A[:]
	r := &lib.C.L[1:][0]
	fmt.Println(p, q, s, r)
}
